name: Tarek Elsayed
headline: Backend Engineer
summary:
Backend Software Engineer specializing in Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript, with hands-on experience building and deploying production applications 
from scratch. Skilled in designing RESTful APIs, backend architecture, authentication systems, CRM integrations, and custom ERP solutions. Experienced 
with MySQL, Redis, AWS cloud deployments, and delivering reliable backend services for web and mobile applications.

experience.title: Backend Software Engineer
bullets: Solely built and launched Mawlha, processing 1,000+ financing applications and 50+ reservation requests, with 150+ vehicles across 70+ brands.
Developed production web and mobile applications using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, MySQL, and Redis.
Managed VPS infrastructure, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI/CD, optimizing deployment and production reliability.
Integrated String CRM APIs and optimized image handling using Cloudinary signed uploads, reducing backend processing overhead.
Supported Swapcar and Baddelha development, infrastructure, and production operations.

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Developed a spare-parts pricing platform using Next.js and Prisma, replacing manual Excel workflows.
Built a centralized system serving 20+ employees across 2 branches, managing pricing for Skoda, Volkswagen, and Audi.
Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and streamlined spare-parts price verification for maintenance teams.

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Built a custom ERP system to replace the company’s legacy ERP, implementing complex business modules and operational workflows.
Developed the system end-to-end across backend, frontend, database logic, and internal process automation.
